title: 第14章【冥婚】逼迫
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李小娥拉着方清的手，另外一只手顺手将她怀中的相框拿掉扔在一旁，脸上洋溢不住的笑容。

“你嫁过去也不吃亏，那马家可是家大业大，再说了那姓马的也是个短命鬼，也没几天了，说不定你刚嫁过去他就死了，你看到时候你不是还能嫁人吗，到时候还能收一笔钱。”

“你也知道咱们家的情况，到时候你弟弟要是没有办法娶到媳妇，不能给你们老方家传宗接代，我和你爸那个死鬼还有什么脸下去见他爸妈。”

方清冷哼一声，“你有没有脸去见他们那是你的事。”

她直起身子将手抽了回来，擦了擦脸上的泪珠，“这件事情之后不管他死不死，我们之间再没有任何关系，我们之间的母女情就此斩断。”

又是响亮的一巴掌落在方清的脸上，方清瘦小的脸上顿时红肿起来，五颗手指印像是烙铁一样印在脸上。

“你什么意思？”

李小娥怒吼道：“长大了，翅膀硬了，不想认这个家了是吧！”

“别说这一次，就是下一次有这事，你也得乖乖给我听话！”

李小娥冷哼一声离开，顺手将门也给反锁起来。

房间中，方清坐在地上抱着相册两眼无神，只有泪珠一滴一滴的落在相框上。

没多久，外面传来了声音，紧接着门被

而那身衣服和鞋子顾原再熟悉不过，正是他找到的这两件物品。

“穿好了，晚上马家就要来接你了。”李小娥冷冷的扔下一句，看都没看方清一眼，仿佛方清并不是自己的女儿，只是一个陌生人。

或者说，是一个可以挣钱的工具。

方清表情冷漠，捡起衣服鞋子换在身上。

虽然穿着一身的囍服，但方清的脸上没有丝毫的开心，相反却是冷漠和怨恨。

大概过了几分钟，外面锣鼓喧天的响起了音乐，还有人群的嘈杂声，显然是马家已经来接方清了。

而这几分钟的方清穿着一身红色的衣服，手中捧着相框小声的抽泣着。

外面的锁被的举起手却停在半空。

随后却骂道：“你个赔钱货，赶紧跟我走，别让马家等急了。”

说着，李小娥一把抓住方清的胳膊将其拽了起来，随后将手中的相框随手扔到地上。

相框顿时裂了无数条缝隙，表面上的玻璃都碎成几块。

这下顾原也才明白了，之前在方清的房间看到的相框为什么是裂的，原来是李小娥摔的。

路上，李小娥一把将红色的盖头盖在方清的头上。

门外已经排起了长队，无数人拥堵在门口朝里张望，他们也想看看新娘子的模样，即使是同一个村子的人。

“你给我好好的，要是敢在这里给我丢脸，我就让你永远也见不到姓顾的。”李小娥咬着牙在方清耳边说道，但脸上却是激动的笑容。

人群中，并看不到新郎官的身影。

Page (1/3)

Li Xiao'e took Fang Qing's hand, and with her other hand, she took off the photo frame from her arms and threw it aside, with an unstoppable smile on her face.

"You won't suffer any loss if you marry. The Ma family is a big family. Besides, the man named Ma is also a short-lived ghost. He may not have been alive for a few days. Maybe he will die just after you marry him. When you see it, you can still marry, and you can still collect a sum of money."

"You also know the situation of our family. If your brother can't find a wife by then and can't continue the family lineage of your old Fang family, what shame will your bastard dad and I have to go see his parents?"

Fang Qing snorted coldly, "Whether you have the nerve to see them or not is your business."

She straightened up and pulled her hand back, wiping the tears on her face, "After this incident, no matter whether he dies or not, there will be no relationship between us anymore, and the mother-daughter relationship between us will be cut off."

Another loud slap fell on Fang Qing's face. Fang Qing's thin face suddenly became red and swollen, and five finger prints were imprinted on his face like a branding iron.

"What do you mean?"

Li Xiao'e roared angrily: "You have grown up and your wings have hardened. You don't want to recognize this family anymore, do you?"

"Don't talk about this time, even if this happens next time, you have to obey me!"

Li Xiao'e snorted and left, locking the door behind her.

In the room, Fang Qing sat on the floor holding a photo album, his eyes dull, only tears falling on the photo frame drop by drop.

Not long after, there was a sound from outside, and then the door was closed

The clothes and shoes were very familiar to Gu Yuan. They were the two items he found.

"Get dressed, the Ma family will pick you up in the evening." Li Xiao'e said coldly, without even looking at Fang Qing, as if Fang Qing was not his daughter, but just a stranger.

In other words, it is a tool that can make money.

Fang Qing had a cold expression as he picked up his clothes and shoes and put them on.

Although he was wearing a uniform, there was no happiness on Fang Qing's face. On the contrary, it was indifference and resentment.

After about a few minutes, gongs and drums rang loudly, and there was noise from the crowd. It was obvious that the Ma family had come to pick up Fang Qing.

In the past few minutes, Fang Qing was wearing red clothes, holding a photo frame in his hands and sobbing quietly.

The person holding the quilt outside raised his hand but stopped in mid-air.

Then he scolded: "You lose money, come with me quickly, don't keep the Ma family waiting."

With that said, Li Xiao'e grabbed Fang Qing's arm and pulled him up, then threw the photo frame in his hand to the ground.

The photo frame suddenly cracked numerous gaps, and the glass on the surface shattered into several pieces.

Only then did Gu Yuan understand why the photo frame he saw in Fang Qing's room was cracked. It turned out that Li Xiao'e had dropped it.

On the way, Li Xiaoe put a red hijab on Fang Qing's head.

There was already a long queue outside the door, and countless people crowded at the door and looked in. They also wanted to see what the bride looked like, even if they were from the same village.

"Be good to me. If you dare to embarrass me here, I will never let you see anyone named Gu." Li Xiao'e gritted her teeth and said in Fang Qing's ear, but there was an excited smile on her face.

In the crowd, the groom could not be seen.
